Matrix uses 100 labels from component_and_logical_visual_ocr_labels.csv in file order: 89 physical components followed by 11 logical bus/ground nodes.

Collapsed anonymous wire endpoints, junction dots, bends, and WN-* nodes into direct named endpoint edges; included physical components, named buses/logical nodes, and the visible GND-1E ground reference.
Edge list contains 100 unique undirected named edges; matrix contains 100 undirected 1-connections.

GND-1E is visually connected by dot-dash GND-A/GND-B reference stubs near the charger area, but the exact named endpoint is crowded by labels and crossings. I mapped these to CB-CHG-A and CB-CHG-B with medium-low confidence rather than introducing anonymous GND-A/GND-B nodes.

Dotted instrument and dashed control lines in the RPS/ESF area were treated as logical connectivity, not power-only connectivity, because they terminate on visible component terminals and the legend names those line styles.
Gaps and crossings without terminal dots between adjacent buses (for example BUS-120A/B, DC-BUS-A/B, FDB-A1/A2, FDB-B1/B2) were not connected.
